title: THE SUPPANDI PRIZE, AWARDED BY MY MOTHER
description: For outstandingly literal research methods: attempting to locate a moving human being using a printed dictionary. The first recorded case of me asking the wrong tool the right question — a mistake I have been carefully repeating in engineering ever since.

title: THE YEAR SOLITUDE BECAME A TOOL
description: After a drop year and a JEE result that didn't go my way, I learned to convert isolation into solitude: a quiet, structured space to think, reset, and finally choose computer science on purpose instead of by default.

title: FIRST COMMIT, SECOND START
description: The year I began my B.Tech in CSE (AI & ML) and started shipping for real: e-vivlio for readers, Yard for shared listening, Cove for login-free calls — three projects that turned "how does this work?" into "watch me build it."
